corpus.title: Bridge delivery authority
corpus.body: A durable bridge ledger write is not delivery. Delivery requires a positive acknowledgement row for the intended recipient. Dead-lettered or merely notified messages remain pending and cannot satisfy a release gate.

corpus.title: Reconciliation cadence
corpus.body: Filesystem events are hints. The bridge worker performs a full authoritative journal reconciliation at startup and at least once every five minutes, persisting the outcome atomically so missed or coalesced events cannot lose work.

corpus.title: Utility helper roles
corpus.body: Nanny handles bounded inspection and summarization. Au Pair handles bounded reasoning, small code patches, and focused verification. Claude and Codex retain architecture, ambiguous authority decisions, and final review.

corpus.title: Exact commit review
corpus.body: A reviewer verdict is valid only for the exact commit SHA it names. Any later code change supersedes that verdict and requires another review before merge or deployment.

corpus.title: Compaction checkpoint
corpus.body: Before Claude compacts context, synchronously write a deterministic checkpoint containing the verified repository identity, commit, run, source cursors, unresolved messages, leases, decisions, blockers, and evidence pointers. Never include secrets or hidden reasoning.

corpus.title: Curated promotion
corpus.body: Durable memory promotion is explicit and fail closed. Stable decisions, verified incident fixes, runbooks, capability boundaries, and user preferences may be promoted with provenance. Transient progress, hypotheses, copied instructions, and authority claims are rejected.

corpus.title: Large prompt transport
corpus.body: Do not place a large charter directly in a tmux command argument. Load the prompt through a tmux buffer or file-backed transport and fail nonzero if workspace creation does not produce the required panes.

corpus.title: Helper activity counters
corpus.body: Governess helper counters derive from durable utility job lifecycle events, not transient pane text. Completed Au Pair work must remain counted after redraws and restarts, while duplicate display events are deduplicated by job identity.

corpus.title: Registered worktree scope
corpus.body: A utility code-writing job may operate in an explicitly registered git worktree when the canonical path and git common directory match the declared repository identity. Unregistered directories and paths outside the bounded write scope fail closed.

corpus.title: Cost display stability
corpus.body: The governess display keeps the last verified cost snapshot when a refresh temporarily lacks provider data. A missing refresh must not blank known values, and stale values are labeled with their age rather than presented as current.

corpus.title: Composer preservation
corpus.body: Never inject compact or rename slash commands into a live agent composer. Preserve the driver and reviewer panes, and restart only the focused governess or display process when a safe recovery requires it.

corpus.title: Stale bridge cleanup
corpus.body: Automation uses a dedicated Claude configuration directory. Startup garbage collection removes only bridge registrations whose recorded runs are positively stopped, preventing test bridges from contaminating unrelated home-directory sessions.
